title.en: A handover can work through either route
title.zh: 交接可以通过两种路径完成

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构活动的两位协调者要确认材料清单，既可约一次双方都能参与的简短讨论，也可在约定回复时段前各自查看书面版本。讨论可以有会前文字，书面也可以留下需要当面澄清的问题；实际安排不必只选一条路线。选择书面不表示不合作，选择直接讨论也不保证理解一致。这里比较安排偏好，仍需另看任务条件和参与者的实际需要。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, coordinators of an invented activity can confirm a materials list in an accessible scheduled conversation or inspect written versions before an agreed reply time. A conversation can include advance notes; written work can identify a question for live clarification. Real arrangements need not use only one route. Writing establishes no lack of cooperation, and discussion guarantees no shared understanding. Compare preferences while checking task conditions and participants’ actual needs separately.

title.zh: 澄清一次实际协同需要

paragraphs.zh: 可为虚构交接各写一个直接讨论版和一个书面版，分别注明需要共享什么、何时需要回应、怎样提问。再问：“这次更看重立即澄清，还是先看完整细节？”两个版本均可保留，不用从均值选职业或要求别人接受你的沟通方式。
paragraphs.en: For a fictional handover, draft live and written versions, each naming the information, response time and way to ask questions. Ask: “For this task, does immediate clarification or inspecting complete details first matter more?” Retain both versions without choosing a career from the mean or requiring someone else to adopt your route.

paragraphs.zh: 这些原创案例帮助比较安排，不是实际工作环境、能力或组织契合的测量。四组各六题，每组第二、第四、第六项换位对齐，完整回答才有独立位置均值；NA不当中点，四份全文始终可读。可以只读或写不发送的草稿，分享公开指南无需披露回答、均值、公司或同事信息。
paragraphs.en: These original examples compare arrangements without measuring an actual workplace, ability or organisational fit. Each of four groups has six items, with positions two, four and six aligned by reversal. Complete ratings produce separate position means; NA is not a midpoint and all four full guides remain readable. Reading or an unsent draft is enough, without sharing answers, means, company or colleague information.

title.en: Clarify the goal, the allowed choices and the review
title.zh: 澄清目标、可选范围与复核

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构展示需要把六张说明卡摆进同一块区域。一种获准安排给出示例顺序，另一种给出相同目标和边界后允许自行排布。想要示例可以是为了理解要求，想自行排布也可能只是熟悉这次材料。两种偏好都不能证明独立能力，示例不是对所有步骤的强制要求，方法选择也不能扩大原本权限。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, six cards must fit an invented display area. One permitted arrangement provides an example sequence; another offers the same goal and limits with a choice of layout. Wanting an example may concern understanding requirements, while wanting choice may concern familiarity with these materials. Neither proves independent ability. An example need not make every step compulsory, and method choice does not expand authority.

title.en: Ask one bounded question about a task arrangement
title.zh: 为任务安排提出一个有边界的问题

paragraphs.zh: 可以只写一项虚构任务的“成果要求”“必须遵循的边界”和“可自行决定的部分”，再拟问题：“这个顺序是规定，还是可参考的示例？”用明确答案了解任务，而非用偏好数字推断自己应该拥有多少自主权。
paragraphs.en: Privately list an invented task’s outcome, mandatory limits and choices left open. Draft: “Is this order required or an example to consider?” Use an explicit answer to understand the task, rather than a preference number to infer how much discretion you should have.

paragraphs.zh: 这些原创案例帮助比较安排，不是实际工作环境、能力或组织契合的测量。四组各六题，每组第二、第四、第六项换位对齐，完整回答才有独立位置均值；NA不当中点，四份全文始终可读。可以只读或写不发送的草稿，分享公开指南无需披露回答、均值、公司或同事信息。

Each of four groups has six items, with positions two, four and six aligned by reversal. Complete ratings produce separate position means; NA is not a midpoint and all four full guides remain readable. Reading or an unsent draft is enough, without sharing answers, means, company or colleague information.

title.en: A new request can wait or enter through a checkpoint
title.zh: 新要求可以等下一轮，也可以经检查点进入

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构小册已确定六页，有人建议再加一张地图。若已约定这一轮保持范围，可以先留到复核；若流程允许，经受影响的人确认，也可以现在调整。一种安排不自动更负责或更灵活。是否有必要改变、谁能决定和增加了什么成本，是均值没有观察的条件。偏好稳定也可以欢迎新信息，偏好修订也不等于每个建议都应立即采纳。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an invented six-page booklet receives a suggestion to add a map. An agreement to keep this cycle stable can leave it for review; a permitted checkpoint can allow a change confirmed by affected people. Neither arrangement is automatically more responsible or flexible. Necessity, decision authority and added costs are conditions the mean does not observe. Stability can welcome new information, and revision does not require accepting every idea immediately.

paragraphs.zh: 可在私人草稿写“现在约定不变的部分”“什么新信息值得重看”“由谁确认调整”。再分别写一个留到下轮的版本和一个在检查点修订的版本，比较所需条件，不用把两种安排排成优劣或据此给团队贴标签。
paragraphs.en: Privately note what stays agreed now, new information worth revisiting and who confirms an adjustment. Draft a next-cycle version and a checkpoint-revision version, comparing their required conditions without ranking them or labelling a team.

paragraphs.zh: 这些原创案例帮助比较安排，不是实际工作环境、能力或组织契合的测量。四组各六题，每组第二、第四、第六项换位对齐，完整回答才有独立位置均值；NA不当中点，四份全文始终可读。可以只读或写不发送的草稿，分享公开指南无需披露回答、均值、公司或同事信息。

Each of four groups has six items, with positions two, four and six aligned by reversal. Complete ratings produce separate position means; NA is not a midpoint and all four full guides remain readable. Reading or an unsent draft is enough, without sharing answers, means, company or colleague information.

title.en: A draft review can focus on a paragraph or a complete section
title.zh: 草稿复核可以看一段，也可以看完整一节

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的说明单要核对两件事：读者是否清楚、整篇顺序是否连贯。前一个问题也许能看一段样稿，后一个需要看到完整部分；两次复核要回答的问题不同。喜欢小块反馈不证明更会学习，喜欢集中反馈也不表示拒绝批评。反馈质量、媒介、时机和复核者可用时间应分别说明，不能用频繁程度替代内容是否有用。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an invented information sheet needs checks of its audience and overall sequence. An audience question may use one sample paragraph, while sequence needs a coherent section. Those reviews answer different questions. Preferring small-piece feedback establishes no greater learning ability, and consolidated feedback implies no rejection of criticism. Describe quality, medium, timing and reviewer availability separately; frequency does not establish usefulness.

title.en: Agree one review question and one time
title.zh: 商定一个复核问题与时间

paragraphs.zh: 可为虚构草稿写一个明确复核问题，再分别设想“先看小片段”和“看完整一节”各需要哪些背景。问：“哪种范围足以回答这一个问题？”不要求持续点评，也不把均值3.0当作每次都没有偏好；可以只在纸上比较后结束。
paragraphs.en: Write one review question for a fictional draft and consider the context needed for a sample and a complete section. Ask: “Which scope is enough to answer this question?” Require no continuous comments or assumption that a mean of 3.0 makes every choice neutral. The comparison can finish on paper.
